About this property

Divyasree Whispers of the Wind (WOW) is a newly launched premium plotted development spread across 38 acres in the picturesque Nandi Valley, located in Doddaballapura Taluk, Bengaluru Rural. This gated community offers 207 luxury villa plots ranging from 1,200 to 4,000 sq. ft., starting at ₹92.4 Lakhs. Designed for peaceful yet high-end living, the project features a 20,000+ sq. ft. clubhouse, wide internal roads, landscaped parks, and world-class infrastructure. Just 20 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport, it’s perfect for a second home or long-term investment. Located in Doddaballapura Taluk, Bengaluru Rural near Nandi Hills, the project enjoys excellent connectivity - just 20 mins from Kempegowda International Airport and 50 mins from Hebbal. It is close to the upcoming Gondola/Cable Car, suburban railway stations, Devanahalli Business Park, Aerospace SEZ, and the future IT investment region between Doddaballapur and Chikkaballapur.
